### 2026-10-06 – Oct 5

**3h**

Oct 5
Well, here goes nothing

Yesterday (it was late, and I didn't have time to write), I did some stuff, including.

Downloading KiCad- took a while, so I didn't really count the time. Then I watched a YT Video on how to import the Care Package. Then I set up all my windows, including the guide, KiCad, Google, and maybe a little ChatGPT (don't worry, I only used it to help translate some of the guide and provide more info; it didn't do anything for me.)

![Screenshot 2026-10-05 190712](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/865zpjCy5G9OC9atYCS9lcJ2wHUyjAn3/56265891861939ba7a6362552693edfe79b11e98f6470f419e7b51505ad780e8.png)

![Screenshot 2026-10-05 193809 1](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/865zpjCy5G9OC9atYCS9lcJ2wHUyjAn3/a69d7af607b211c250d0d3da907a9d4aeee45f4b31f40690b6a666db1363f36a.png)

Sorry if this isn't long enough or is missing things: this is my first time. :)

### 2026-10-11 – Oct 11- finishing

**6.3h**

Oct 11- finishing
It turns out 30$ is a pretty hard tier to stay under. Like, REALLY hard, but let's go in order

First, I finished up Aurino and fixed the errors I got, which was difficult because it was a single character that was wrong, so it took a second to hunt it down.

![Screenshot 2026-10-11 111511](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/865zpjCy5G9OC9atYCS9lcJ2wHUyjAn3/b6d709f7665fec70f275b6c6e0df9131e340a48ec2515531dd73945251617bda.png)

Then I got started on the next phase, updating my repo. I put my Arduino code in and got the gerbers, which took a while because the save wasn't working, and i was saving it to the wrong place

![Screenshot 2026-10-11 173258](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/865zpjCy5G9OC9atYCS9lcJ2wHUyjAn3/b74c267fa0b1dd342d61847233849ac360b3fa34a83bbb79d955b70612e93888.png)
Then I began what would take the rest of my time- shopping for parts.
Right off, I had a hard time finding things, searching Amazon, only to find 50-packs at high prices, with big money for shipping, that wouldn't fit my budget.

![Screenshot 2026-10-11 154301](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/865zpjCy5G9OC9atYCS9lcJ2wHUyjAn3/e10c8cdd3acc3629ab7d308adf5c10e59e9fb8812c01a3a7f0dabf0725f1a92f.png)
I decided to get on Slack to ask for help and got the names of some good sites that would actually give me good prices.
i jumped on JLCPCB, put in my Gerber files, and got my price.
![Screenshot 2026-10-11 174420](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/865zpjCy5G9OC9atYCS9lcJ2wHUyjAn3/76b32e3a05cd6ed5912128c8f3539b508767d9a5ea6919200e4385378605bf08.png)
Then I set out to LCSC to find parts, but they didn't carry the parts at all, and if they did, the shipping was out of budget.

![Screenshot 2026-10-11 174640](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/865zpjCy5G9OC9atYCS9lcJ2wHUyjAn3/586872448056b1f9475ee3e6f6e19a6b7c28dca99f69e0fd8ec8279e0af45143.png)

So after getting back on Slack, I went to AliExpress, which ended up having everything I needed — sort of. While the prices were low, $ 10 was being charged for the PCB board; I only had ~$ 28 to spend on my parts. So I began hunting for the cheapest parts I could find.

![Screenshot 2026-10-11 162010](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/865zpjCy5G9OC9atYCS9lcJ2wHUyjAn3/c8c4cdda711c7fead5ee5698f60f09b834c5e629bdb6aad9038b42aebb7f1b37.png)

This took a while because of name mistranslations, and sometimes it was very hard to tell compatibility, the true price, and shipping. So I ground that out. i also had issues coordinating with KiCad's Auto BOM and everyone's suggestions on Slack (it's not their fault I have terrible tab management)

![Screenshot 2026-10-11 154301](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/865zpjCy5G9OC9atYCS9lcJ2wHUyjAn3/e10c8cdd3acc3629ab7d308adf5c10e59e9fb8812c01a3a7f0dabf0725f1a92f.png)

Finally, after finishing looking for parts and putting them into my BOM, I turned to my repo and worked on imports and the README

![Screenshot 2026-10-11 191453](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/865zpjCy5G9OC9atYCS9lcJ2wHUyjAn3/0e76d29b6d81b9a64cbcd4c437a50b3d1dd53d36b538d2e2420f7a688d536e15.png)

DONE

TL;DR: finished up Arduino, shopped for parts, finished
